notes.title: Release Notes 0.8.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed Issues:
	•	Fixed a bug that previously caused players to get stuck on the stairs leading to the Shunter in chapter 5.
	•	Adjusted all texts in chapter 1-8
	•	Fixed a problem that sometimes caused the camera to get stuck after using the inventory
	•	Fixed multiple problems with jumping graphics related to the 2D parallax, making it work as expected now.
	•	Resolved an issue with a disappearing shovel, which players encountered earlier in chapter 7.
	•	Improved audio fade between levels.
	•	Added a new room to the Catacombs (Chapter 7),
	•	Adjusted puzzles in the Catacombs (Chapter 7) to improve the overall gameplay experience.
	•	Fixed several problems on the stairs, which was a source of frustration for players.
	•	Fixed sounds that previously did not work after the intro cutscenes
	•	Addressed many other issues that were present in the previous release.
